desc:
👋 Welcome to Steal a House! 🏠

How to Play:
🚗 Drive around the map and find houses to steal!
🏠 Tow houses back to your base and collect them.
💰 Earn cash from your houses.
🚙 Buy and upgrade to better cars to tow houses faster!
💎 Discover and collect rare houses.
⚡ Upgrade your vehicles and become the ultimate house hauler!
👑 Build your collection, get rich, and dominate the map!

🎮 Supports desktop, mobile, tablet, and console.
